title: AIIMS Delhi Notification 2026 - Apply Online for Various Project Research Scientist III Posts
description: The All India Institute of Medical Sciences, Delhi (AIIMS Delhi) has officially announced the notification for the recruitment of various Project Research Scientist III Posts. Candidates with an MDS can apply for the AIIMS Delhi Notification 2026 . Here we have included the age limit, selection process, salary structure, education details, application fee, and how to apply for these posts.
